purpose: Teach: 一体化/つとめ/マネージメント/結集/少人数/樹立/取り込ん/交互

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、各部の業務を一体化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each word lands with weight. Slow, deliberate pace. No negotiation in the tone—this is a directive stated as fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修講師のおつとめも継続いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'll continue handling the training responsibilities as well.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight nod in the voice on 「はい」. Professional but not stiff—acknowledging the order with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、現場のマネージメント能力を磨かせろ
lines.en: Polish the management capabilities at our operational sites.
lines.style: Steady, instructional tone. Crisp attack on each clause. Measured pace—demanding execution without harshness. Posture of someone accustomed to being followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規事業に総力を結集します
lines.en: Understood. We'll consolidate all resources toward the new business venture.
lines.style: Assured affirmation. A beat of quiet confidence behind the words. Professional cadence—not rushing, not dragging. Signaling readiness without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 少人数チームでの開発を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen development work in small, focused teams.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful. Light emphasis on 「強化しろ」 — this is the priority. Even pace, no softening. The voice of someone who knows what works.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場の樹立を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll accelerate the establishment of the new factory.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Professional register—no uncertainty. Slightly faster pace than the boss, reflecting eagerness to act on the directive without losing composure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外案件を取り込んでいけ
lines.style: Sharp, forward-looking tone. Quick attack on the opening. Brisk pace. The voice of strategic expansion—focused and non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議スケジュールを交互に組みます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the meeting schedule to coordinate across both priorities.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment—slightly more deliberate than before. A closing cadence. Professional warmth underneath the formality—signal that the briefing is landing and moving into action.
